text: Parental leave one-fifth requests are piling up. Remember it's up to 4 months full-time equivalent per child.

author: Tom Verhoeven
text: Is a medical certificate needed from day 1 for a one-day absence? Depends on the client's work regulations right?

author: Koen Willems
text: Correct, from day 1 only if the employer or CLA requires it, otherwise from day 2. Certificate to HR within two working days.
